scope: Partial correction of transport budget and failure diagnostics only. Dynamic grain accreditation is NOT implemented by this change.

root_cause.demonstrated: ResearchBinding constructs every discovered LogicalTable with grain=(). AskRegistry.register rejects these tables before executing any independent raw control. The six saved audit entries all state discovered_grain_and_business_semantics_not_accredited. Thus the final two SUM claims lack independent populations.
missing_evidence: Independent raw population with key uniqueness, currency, provenance and classification dependencies
Independently verified ranking/completeness dependencies, not just two scalar claims
root_cause.general_or_specific: General missing discovered-source grain propagation/accreditation, demonstrated for this projection. Not proof that all dynamic SQL shapes can be accredited.
root_cause.independent_success: The separate verify.py bounded raw reads checked line/document/customer keys, canonical classification, Decimal monthly/customer/SKU reconciliation. independent.json records the aggregates and checks but does not retain those raw populations.
root_cause.requested_repair: Generic feedback called the missing evidence a contradiction and asked Luna to query, revise or withdraw. Luna repeated totals/rankings; this cannot establish a trusted grain contract.
root_cause.budget: The last saved history plus feedback reproduces observation_byte_budget using the exact original pure function. Repeated manifests and feedback column descriptions consume the unchanged 32768-byte transport budget.
root_cause.not_claimed: No attribution to incorrect Luna arithmetic, model failure, Foundation mutation or insufficient global limits.

correction.adaptive_research.py: Reference a rejected-claim column by its issued descriptor ID when exact metadata equality holds; encode repeated descriptor field names once. Preserve observed values, reasons, required actions and dependencies. Keep final budget guard and existing checks.
correction.ask_verifier.py: Surface the actual persisted control failure instead of replacing it with a generic missing-population reason. Never promote the claim.
correction.claim_evidence.py: Explain that missing grain/provenance/semantics is not an arithmetic contradiction and repeated aggregates cannot repair it.
correction.not_done: No dynamic grain or semantic lineage accreditation added. No automatic verification of the six requested business assertions. No final freeze/readiness.

replay.limitations: This is a transport replay, not a new SQL result or independent claim verification. Existing history sample compaction remains explicit; it cannot certify ranking completeness.
